money_market.source: WIBOR fixings of 2 Apr 2026 (GPW Benchmark delayed data); repo from the Treasury BondSpot Poland session of 2 Apr 2026. Funding = nominal-weighted nearest-start, shortest special repo (start T+0, 5 days; no trade of <= 3 days) (3.50%).

irs.source: PLN IRS vs 6M WIBOR at the 2 Apr 2026 close: LSEG end-of-day interbank bid rates in the Erste Bank Polska Codziennik of 3 Apr 2026 (Good Friday issue, tables headed 02.04.2026 = C; the 7 Apr issue is headed 06/04, after C, and is not used) (table headed 02.04.2026; only the 2 Apr 2026 levels are used). Bid side, so roughly 1-2bp below mid. 7Y not available. PCHIP interpolation through 6M WIBOR and the pillars; beyond 10Y extrapolated.
irs.short_source: PLN IRS at the 2 Apr 2026 close (LSEG bid via Erste), WIBOR fixings 2 Apr 2026

curve.source: NSS zero curve fitted to BondSpot closing fixings of 2 Apr 2026; front end anchored at a 3M zero of 3.49% = average of sub-1Y fixed POLGB yields (DS0726 3.33%, PS1026 3.54%, OK0127 3.61%).
